description: This file implements the COMRPCStarter class responsible for managing plugin activation, including retries and error handling. It includes methods for activating plugins with status logging, utilizing connector interfaces, and handling control flow for plugin startup.

classes.name: COMRPCStarter
classes.description: Class responsible for starting and activating plugins with retry logic.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin starter with the plugin name.

methods.description: Attempts to activate the plugin with retries, handling errors, and logging progress.

methods.description: Attempts to activate the plugin repeatedly until success or maximum retries are reached, with logging and delay between attempts.
